docs.title: Course Information
docs.text:
• Course Name：Advanced Computer Networking (COMP6103P.03)
  • Time: 19:30 - 21:55, Thursday, 5th March 2026 - 2nd July 2026
  • Venue: GT-A405, High Tech Campus
  • Instructor：Junxue ZHANG (snowzjx at ustc dot edu dot cn)
  • TAs:
    • Wenbo LI (wenboli at mail dot ustc dot edu dot cn)

Exam and Essay Information

The final exam is expected to be held on Monday, June 22, 2026, 09:00-11:00 at G2-B302, #2 Academic Building, High Tech Campus. The exam lasts 2 hours and accounts for 60% of the final grade. It is an open-book exam, but electrical devices are not allowed.

The assignment is a topic review essay, accounting for 40% of the final grade. The essay should include at least 10 papers. Please submit the essay before the final exam by email to 2176406119@qq.com. The email subject and attachment should be named in the format Name-StudentID-essay.

Plagiarism and GenAI Policy: Plagiarism will receive a zero mark. LLM-based tools, such as ChatGPT and DeepSeek, and traditional AI-assisted writing tools, such as Grammarly, may be used only to improve the presentation and clarity of your essay. They must not be used to generate any substantive content.

Grade Release

The grades for Advanced Computer Network have been released. If you would like to request paper checking, please contact me before July 15, 2026.

docs.title: Syllabus
docs.text: Lecture Topic Paper Slides 1 DCN A Scalable, Commodity Data Center Network Architecture, SIGCOMM 2008 Intro & FatTree 2 DCN Data Center TCP (DCTCP), SIGCOMM 2010 DCTCP 3 DCN Information-Agnostic Flow Scheduling for Commodity Data Centers, NSDI 2015 PIAS 4 DCN CONGA: Distributed Congestion-aware Load Balancing for Datacenters, SIGCOMM 2014 CONGA 5 DCN RDMA over Commodity Ethernet at Scale, SIGCOMM 2016 RDMA 6 SDN OpenFlow: Enabling Innovation in Campus Networks, SIGCOMM CCR 2008  P4: Programming Protocol-Independent Packet Processors, SIGCOMM CCR 2014 SDN 7 SDN ATP: In-network Aggregation for Multi-tenant Learning, NSDI 2021 ATP 8 SDN PINT: Probabilistic In-band Network Telemetry, SIGCOMM 2020 PINT 9 Protocol QUIC: Design and Internet-Scale Deployment, SIGCOMM 2017 QUIC 10 Protocol PCC: Re-architecting Congestion Control for Consistent High Performance, NSDI 2015 PCC 11 Protocol PCC Vivace: Online-Learning Congestion Control, NSDI 2018 PCC Vivace 12 Protocol Pensieve: Neural Adaptive Video Streaming with Pensieve, SIGCOMM 2017 Pensieve 13 Net4AI TopoOpt: Co-optimizing Network Topology and Parallelization Strategy for Distributed Training Jobs, NSDI 2023 TopoOpt 14 Net4AI MLT: Towards Domain-Specific Network Transport for Distributed DNN Training, NSDI 2024 MLT 15 Net4AI MegaScale: Scaling Large Language Model Training to More Than 10,000 GPUs, NSDI 2024 MegaScale
